summary: Future FinTech Group Inc., through its wholly-owned subsidiary Future Commercial Group Limited, entered into a Share Purchase Agreement on June 12, 2026, to acquire a 20% equity interest in Xi'an Changshida Information Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese AI firm focused on healthcare and smart city technologies. The aggregate purchase price is RMB 44,000,000 (approximately US$6.46 million), comprising RMB 40,000,000 in cash and 493,062 shares of Future FinTech common stock valued at RMB 4,000,000. Consideration is due within ten days of completing the equity transfer and PRC registration. The shares are issued under Regulation S exemption. Closing is subject to customary conditions. This strategic minority stake positions Future FinTech in the AI sector; watch for completion of PRC regulatory filings and any subsequent milestones or adjustments.
